_comment: Copy to classify.rules.json (gitignored) and replace with your own patterns.
Every pattern is a case-insensitive JavaScript regular expression, as a JSON string,
so backslashes must be doubled: \b becomes \\b.
internalDescriptions: money you moved between accounts you already own.
Anchor these to exact phrases. Banks put the account holder's name on BOTH a
self-transfer and an incoming salary, so a bare surname will reclassify your pay
as internal movement and silently double your reported savings rate.
refundDescriptions: money coming back, not money earned — insurance claims,
merchant refunds, overpayments returned. Only ever tested against inflows.
Beware \\b before a word your bank jams onto the end of another one:
incomeRules: who pays you, in priority order — the first match wins, so put
the specific pattern above the general one. An inflow that matches nothing
is still counted as income; it just lands in the 'Uncategorised' bucket and
in the review queue. An overly broad pattern is the dangerous kind.
